text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. To report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing and Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard café area located at 768 Dundas Street West, Markham Street flankage.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the item until its June 25, 2019 meeting.
